content: Naturally, similar works in collecting corpora in Indigenous languages of Latin America are abundant, but very few, if any, have the scale and potential of our resource to be useful in many downstream language-specific and inter-disciplinary applications. A general overview of the state of NLP for the under-represented languages of the Americas can be found at BIBREF26. To name a few of the many notable works, BIBREF27 created a parallel Mixtec-Spanish corpus for Machine Translation and BIBREF28 created lexical resources for Arapaho, while BIBREF29 and BIBREF30 focused on building speech corpora for Southern Quechua and Chatino respectively.
